title: Friday Teacher Plan
note: One turn-in per grade, at the end of class. Due Sunday 11:59 PM.

4th Period.goal: By the end of class, my live game builds a row of my new bricks, I can explain my factory method with the video's words, and my doc is turned in once.
4th Period.exitTicket: No exit ticket: the turn-in doc (Answers tab) is today's one turn-in.
prep: Friday turn-in doc posted (Answers tab as its own tab)
Live game links from Thursday handy to spot-check

segments.title: Blooket quiz
segments.do: Review Thursday: if-statement, passing the type, Commit/Sync/hard refresh.
segments.why: Spiral review right before they finish the build.
tips: Start before the bell.

segments.title: Review answers + today's goal
segments.do: Review misses, then the grading: 85 for every box even if the game breaks, 15 for a live new row.
segments.why: Maslow: safety before the big grade.
tips: Say: turn in once, at the end.

segments.title: Finish, Answers tab, or Future Engineer
segments.do: Students confirm the new row is live, fill in Parts 1–2 of the Answers tab, then Future Engineer.
segments.why: Bloom Apply/Evaluate: explain their own code with the video's words.
tips: Most common bug: makeBricks never passes the type.
Color not showing: drawBricks ignores brick.color.
Watch for pasted AI answers in Part 2: ask them to say it out loud.

segments.title: Gallery play
segments.do: Each student plays 2 classmates' live games and names one thing their brick does well.
tips: Only live links: no Codespaces.

segments.title: Final check + turn in
segments.do: Check the link opens the game, every box is filled, then turn in once.
tips: Not finished? Due Sunday 11:59 PM.

watchFor: Links to the repo or Codespace instead of github.io.

6th Period.topic: TinkerCAD Truss Bridge: stability test + turn-in
6th Period.goal: By the end of class, my bridge stays on its two cubes in Sim Lab when a box drops onto its deck, and I have turned in a screenshot taken while it plays and my share link.
6th Period.exitTicket: No exit ticket: the Answers tab (screenshot, share link, what happened) is today's one turn-in.
prep: Your own bridge open in Sim Lab to demo Static

segments.title: Blooket quiz
segments.do: Review Thursday: top chord, group then lift, lift 20, 60 mm gap.
tips: Note the most-missed question.

segments.title: Review answers + today's goal
segments.do: Review misses. Name the limit: Sim Lab shows stability, not weight or breaking.
segments.why: Honest about the tool, and sets up next week's popsicle-stick challenge.
tips: Ask: what CAN'T TinkerCAD tell us?

segments.title: We do: Sim Lab setup
segments.do: Open Sim Lab, set both cubes to Static, leave the bridge free, press Play, then Stop.
segments.why: Fully worked round before their own test.
tips: If the bridge falls through the cubes, it's sitting inside them: lift to exactly 20.

segments.title: You do: drop test
segments.do: Box 20×20×20 above the middle of the deck, lifted 60. Play and watch it land.
segments.why: Bloom Evaluate: does the design stay up?
tips: Bridge falls off: both ends must rest on the cubes.
Early finishers: off-center drop or wider gap.

segments.title: Screenshot + share link
segments.do: Screenshot while playing (Ctrl + Shift + Show windows), copy the share link, paste both in the Answers tab, answer #3.
tips: Paused/stopped screenshots don't show the test.

segments.title: Gallery walk
segments.do: See 2 classmates' bridges in Sim Lab.
tips: Preview: next week, a real popsicle-stick bridge, 30 cm, 5 lbs.

segments.title: Turn in
segments.do: Turn in once on Google Classroom.
tips: Due Sunday if not done.

watchFor: Bridge set to Static (the test proves nothing).
Sim Lab button not found: it's top right.

7th Period.goal: By the end of class, my group has built our second side truss on top of our drawing, joined both sides with cross pieces if we have time, and turned in a photo of our bridge.
7th Period.exitTicket: No exit ticket: the group's Answers page with a bridge photo is today's one turn-in.
prep: Group bags, drawings, sticks, and side 1 handed back
Friday Answers page posted (one per group)

segments.title: Blooket quiz
segments.do: Review Thursday: build on the drawing, Checker, glue squares, cut along the flutes.
tips: Hand bags back after the quiz.

segments.title: Review answers + today's goal
segments.do: Read the goal: side 2 matches side 1, join if time.
segments.why: Clear target for a long build.

segments.title: Roles by birthday
segments.do: Youngest Builder, second youngest Cutter, second oldest Materials Manager, oldest Checker. Group of 3: oldest also MM. Group of 5: two Builders.
segments.why: Complex Instruction: no one decides roles.
tips: New roles from yesterday: everyone works on side 2.

segments.title: You do: build side 2 on the drawing
segments.do: Bottom chord, 6 diagonals, top chord, each checked before glue. MM cuts 4 cross pieces.
tips: Press every glue square 30 seconds.
Groups that finish side 2: join both sides with cross pieces.

segments.title: Check: stack side 2 on side 1
segments.do: Checker stacks the sides and fixes anything that doesn't match.

segments.title: Photo + Answers page, turn in
segments.do: Checker takes the photo; group fills in the Answers page and turns in once.
tips: First names only.

segments.title: Clean up + set to dry
segments.do: Scraps in bin, tools back, bridge flat on the shelf.
segments.why: Ready for next week's load test.
tips: Count scissors.

watchFor: Pieces glued before the Checker checks.
Glue sticks too weak for cardboard.

accommodations: Goal reviewed after the quiz, numbered steps, worked example first, checklists, sentence frames on the Answers tab.
Video and bridge words with pictures; frames on every written answer.
Lexend Deca; read aloud; speech-to-text OK; spelling not graded.
Timed chunks, visual timer, hands-on roles in 6th.
Dictation on written answers; extended time to Sunday; shortened floor: 8th Part 1 only, 7th screenshot only, 6th photo of side 1.
frameworks: Every grade turns in the week's product.
Points known up front, one turn-in, Sunday deadline.
Evaluate: test it, explain it, compare it.
